statement: Let (M, g, K) be a smooth connected orientable initial-data exterior, diffeomorphic to R4 minus an open ball, complete up to its connected compact boundary S ∼ = S3, and with one asymptotically flat end. Here K is a symmetric covariant two-tensor. Assume the vacuum constraint equations with zero cosmological constant and maximality: Rg + (trg K)2 − |K|2 g = 0, divg K − (trg K)g  = 0, trg K = 0. (16.1) Assume a smooth effective T2 = U(1) × U(1) action preserving g, K which, in an asymptotically Euclidean chart R4 = C2, is (eiα , eiβ ) · (z1, z2) = (eiα z1, eiβ z2) at all sufficiently large radii. No cohomogeneity-one assumption is made. In that chart suppose gij − δij = O2(r−q ), Kij = O1(r−q−1 ), q > 1. (16.2) Suppose the following ADM limits exist and are finite: E = 1 6ω3 lim r→∞ Z |x|=r (∂jgij − ∂igjj)νi δ dAδ, (16.3) Pi = 1 3ω3 lim r→∞ Z |x|=r Kij − (trg K)gij  νj δ dAδ. (16.4) Assume P = 0 and E > 0. Orient S by its unit normal ν toward the end and set HS = divS ν. Suppose ΘK(S) := HS + trS K = 0. (16.5) Suppose S is outermost toward the end: there is no compact smooth embedded two-sided hyper- surface in the interior enclosing S, oriented toward the end, with ΘK ≤ 0 everywhere. Suppose also that S is outer area-minimizing: every compact smooth embedded enclosing hypersurface has three-volume at least A = |S|g. Disconnected and noninvariant enclosing competitors are included. Then E ≥ 1 2  A 2π2 2/3 . (16.6)
